{"metadata":{"description":"Verdict-based context compaction for DeepSeek Harness — replaces lossy LLM summaries with fast keep/truncate/drop decisions from jev-latest; everything kept stays verbatim. Port of tamaratran/fast-jev-compaction.","id":"gh:1378434612","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"fast-compaction-dsh","slug":"kolawong/fast-compaction-dsh","topics":["compaction","context-management","cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","jev","llm"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Verdict-based context compaction for DeepSeek Harness — replaces lossy LLM summaries with fast keep/"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"truncate/drop decisions from jev-latest; everything kept stays verbatim. Port of tamaratran/fast-jev"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"p decisions from jev-latest; everything kept stays verbatim. Port of tamaratran/fast-jev-compaction."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# fast-compaction-dsh"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**Verdict-based context compaction for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).** Replaces the lossy compaction summa"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ry with fast per-call keep/truncate/drop decisions from `jev-latest` — everything kept stays **verba"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"tim**, nothing is ever rewritten."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"A DSH port of tamaratran/fast-jev-compaction (MIT), adapted to the DSH compaction capability seam."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What and why"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Most context compaction asks an LLM to summarize old turns. A summary is lossy: a file path, an exac"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"t error, a constraint, or a command can disappear even when it matters later. This plugin never rewr"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ites anything. When compaction triggers, every tool call and tool result in the compacted region is "},{"id":"p7s4","text":"scored by `jev-latest` through the TypeSafe System One endpoint; stale calls are deleted, half-stale"},{"id":"p7s5","text":" results are truncated to a bounded head, and everything else stays byte-for-byte. User and assistan"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"t text is never removed."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"On any failure — a missing `TYPESAFE_API_KEY`, a Jev error, malformed answers, an unfittable history"},{"id":"p8s2","text":", or an insufficient reduction — it falls back to the shipped `compaction-basic` summarizer, exactly"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" like the original Claude Code hook falls back to Claude Code's built-in summary."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"1. Every `tool-call` is paired with its `tool-result` by call id. Calls in the first message and the"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" newest `preserveRecentMessages` (default 6) messages are pinned and never touched.
2. The **state**"},{"id":"p10s3","text":" sent to Jev is the whole compacted region, oldest first, with every tool result replaced by a short"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" note (`ok, 4213 chars (omitted)`). Tool inputs and texts are included — nothing is summarized.
3. T"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"he state is fitted into `maxStateTokens` (25k default) in stages: tool inputs truncated 1000 → 200 →"},{"id":"p10s6","text":" 60 chars; long texts abridged to head + tail, oldest non-pinned first; old messages collapsed to a "},{"id":"p10s7","text":"note; old calls reduced to one line each; old call-less messages left out; runs of call-only message"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"s folded. If it still does not fit, the plugin falls back.
4. For every non-pinned call Jev gets two"},{"id":"p10s9","text":" `noul` questions: should the **call** stay (knowing it was made, with its input, still matters), an"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"d should the **result** stay verbatim (its contents are still needed and re-running the tool would n"},{"id":"p10s11","text":"ot do).
5. Questions are batched so state plus questions stays under `maxRequestTokens` (30k default"},{"id":"p10s12","text":"); batches run concurrently and answers are merged.
6. Decisions against `keepThreshold` (default 0."},{"id":"p10s13","text":"5): `keepResult` ≥ threshold → keep both verbatim; else `keepCall` ≥ threshold → keep the call, trun"},{"id":"p10s14","text":"cate the result to its first `truncateHeadChars` (default 300) characters plus a note; else → drop t"},{"id":"p10s15","text":"he call together with its result.
7. The region is rebuilt as a verbatim transcript checkpoint (the "},{"id":"p10s16","text":"DSH seam replaces the shadowed surface span with one durable user message), with role labels and the"},{"id":"p10s17","text":" kept tool activity inline."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Measured on a real region: the Jev scoring round-trip takes **~700 ms**."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## How it plugs into DSH"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"DSH exposes compaction as a capability seam: `ctx.compaction` (service definition), an engine provid"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"er (`compaction-basic`), and the `/compact` consumer. The engine's single documented customization h"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"ook is `summarize()` — this plugin subclasses `BasicCompactionEngine` and overrides only that hook, "},{"id":"p13s4","text":"so region selection, the durable transaction (lock, events, stability checks, shrink validation), ch"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"eckpoint framing, and `/compact` keep working unchanged."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The shipped `standard` agent preset mounts `compaction-basic` inside an isolated `compaction` realm,"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" so the engine row must be mounted from an **agent preset patch** — not from a profile-level `cordis"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ne row must be mounted from an **agent preset patch** — not from a profile-level `cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Then point your default preset at it in `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Restart DSH. New sessions compact through `jev-latest`; watch the log for `fast-compaction-dsh: kept"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" N/M calls verbatim (…)`."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The same package also ships the **Web settings card** for that engine (the `fast-compaction-dsh/web`"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" and `fast-compaction-dsh/client` entries under `web/`). To get the card, add the package to the web"},{"id":"p19s3","text":" profile and enable the bundle, then restart:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The bundle patch only mounts the settings-namespace entry in the web profile; the engine keeps being"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" mounted by the agent preset above, and the web profile never loads `src/index.ts`."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Seeing the effect"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"No command line needed — the GUI has two layers, plus two optional channels:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"1. **Chat marker**: after a compaction, the chat shows an expandable marker (`N items · M tokens`); "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"expanding it shows the verbatim transcript the model now sees, with `[fast-compaction-dsh truncated "},{"id":"p24s3","text":"…]` notes where results were cut.
2. **Trajectory tab (the verdict details live here)**: switch the "},{"id":"p24s4","text":"session view to the **Trajectory** tab → find the `Compaction` group → click the compacted cell. The"},{"id":"p24s5","text":" inspector has two tabs:
- **Summary**: the rebuilt transcript (the context the model now sees), ren"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"dered as Markdown;
- **Raw Output**: block 1 is a **readable verdict report** this plugin emits (sta"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"ts header + an aligned table of each tool call's `keepCall`/`keepResult` probabilities and final act"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"ion), block 2 is the raw `{decisions, stats, stateStage}` JSON.
3. **Inspector script** (offline, re"},{"id":"p24s9","text":"ad-only — handy for a cross-session overview):"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Renders each compaction's stats and per-call verdict table (parsed from the JSON block of the `compa"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ction/summary` event's `rawOutput`). `--json` for machine-readable output.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- Node.js ≥ 22.19 (the plugin is TypeScript loaded directly by DSH's loader via type stripping).
- A"},{"id":"p28s2","text":" DeepSeek Harness checkout (developer preview) — for development and for the `link:` dev dependencie"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"s, clone it as a **sibling directory** of this repo (or adjust the `link:` paths in `package.json`)."},{"id":"p28s4","text":"
- A TypeSafe API key: `export TYPESAFE_API_KEY=...` in the DSH process environment (or `apiKey` in "},{"id":"p28s5","text":"the preset row's `config`). Without a key the plugin behaves exactly like `compaction-basic`."}],"truncated":true}
